memo: New part A of the Opus plan audit (10-28): PubChem mid-slot insertion on our best (e3f465oc-1 0.467 = f465 + own COCONUT + lfrag; base dmitriigluzdov f465 lineage, credited in kernels/e3/SOURCE.txt). After every base rule, for molecules the base treats as library-weak (lib_max < LIB_TAU 0.9): keep the final top 10, insert up to 5 structures from the base's own PubChem-only channel (PC, outside the candidate pool, ordered by z(f.z FPNet A+B+fold0) + popularity) that have rank 1's molecular formula and are not already listed (metric identity), then the rest, cut at 25 (build.py pcins=10,5). Why: f465's PubChem channel reaches the final list only as a rank-1 promotion or via interleave slots that later stages push out; on dmitriigluzdov's natural-product panel with the truth removed from the pool, MRR is 0.361 and the hidden LB 0.47 looks like that scenario. Effect size: audit panel estimate 0.361 -> 0.396-0.399 on the removed scenario with -0.002..-0.012 on in-pool scenarios; net +2-3 of ~400 hidden molecules if ~40% are the removed type (my own estimate ~1). Hypothesis: LB >= 0.475. Not done yet: the leak-free panel rescoring (fold-safe FPNet k per fold) and the confidence gate C.
